hooks.name: ADR Decision Logger
hooks.description: After modifying specification or architecture files, determine if an architectural decision was made and log it appropriately.

action.prompt: A specification or architecture file was modified. Determine: (1) Was an architectural decision made? (2) If yes, does it require a new ADR or can it be logged in docs/architecture/decision-log.md? (3) If a new ADR is needed, stop and recommend creating one before continuing. Log format: Date, Decision, Reason, Alternatives considered, Impact, Related ADR, Related spec, Related milestone.
